topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on cancer evolution and outlines the key learning objectives for the session.

topics.label: Cell-intrinsic drivers of clonal selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cell-intrinsic alterations confer competitive growth advantages to drive clonal expansion during tumor initiation.

topics.label: Cell of origin and stem cell hierarchies in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the role of tissue hierarchy and stemness, investigating whether cancers originate in stem cells or transit amplifying progenitor cells.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory drivers of cancer progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate that cancer development and maintenance depend on external microenvironmental support and inflammatory signaling rather than cellular mutations alone.

topics.label: Technological approaches to investigating tumor microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the experimental and computational technologies used to map tumor heterogeneity and microenvironmental interactions in human tissues.

topics.label: Multifactorial synthesis of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides an overarching synthesis of how cellular susceptibility, accumulated alterations, and microenvironmental pressures converge during cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of next session
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
